mapper.sql: id, title, description, original_file_name, object_key, file_type, content_type, file_size, duration_ms, width, height, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
select v.id, v.title, v.description, v.original_file_name, v.object_key, v.file_type, v.content_type, v.file_size, v.duration_ms, v.width, v.height, v.status, v.created_by, v.created_at, v.updated_at, task.status as process_status, task.current_step as failure_step, step.error_message as failure_message from ai_media_video v left join ai_media_process_task task on task.id = ( select latest_task.id from ai_media_process_task latest_task where latest_task.video_id = v.id order by latest_task.id desc limit 1 ) left join ai_media_process_step step on step.task_id = task.id and step.step_code = task.current_step
(v.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.original_file_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and ((#{processStatus} = 'NOT_STARTED' and task.id is null) or (#{processStatus} != 'NOT_STARTED' and task.status = #{processStatus}))
order by v.created_at desc, v.id desc
